plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: The ux-design role on contract v3: turns the accepted problem (governing hypothesis/product-record) into screen/flow/wireframe specs concrete enough to build from. Directive carries the four facets — same-job exemplar research, governing-record survey, spec proposal, and a quality bar (complete states, heuristic + accessibility floors, every element traced to a recorded need). Spec only, never implementation; loop_state reviewed is this role's terminal record state.
